steps.code:
# Let's define the list of songs from the note and process the remaining ones.
songs = [
    ("Endless Roads", ["Aria Sterling"]),
    ("Where Shadows Come to Life", ["Olivia Roberts"]),
    ("Whispers of the Heart", ["Lily Moon", "Zoey James"]),
    ("Torn Apart", ["Evelyn Rose"]),
    ("The Ghosts of Our Past", ["Mia Sullivan"]),
    ("Final Goodbye", ["Dylan Stone"]),
    ("In the Light of Dying Stars", ["Lucas Grey", "Velvet Echo"]),
    ("Heaven's Tears", ["Carter Knight"]),
    ("In the Chambers of My Mind", ["Jasper Skye"]),
    ("Echoes from the Abyss", ["Noah Bennett"]),
    ("Trapped in a Daydream", ["Nova Harmony"])
]

# We already added the first one, so process from index 1 onwards.
for title, artists in songs[1:]:
    query = title + " " + " ".join(artists)
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find the exact match
    found = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            expected_artists = [a.lower() for a in artists]
            if all(any(ea in sa for ea in expected_artists) for sa in song_artists) and len(song_artists) == len(expected_artists):
                found = song
                break
    if found:
        print(f"Found: {found['title']} by {[a['name'] for a in found['artists']]} (id={found['song_id']})")
        add_resp = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=654, song_id=found['song_id'], access_token=spotify_token)
        print(add_resp)
    else:
        print(f"Not found: {title} by {artists}")
